title: Concrete native open operations and representative maps
statement: Fix a finite field k₀ and a prime ℓ invertible in k₀, and use the actual Weil-sheaf categories, inverse images and open extensions of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. Localize each exact module pullback and exact open extension to their ordinary derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For composable k₀-maps j:V→W and p:W→Y, the comparison from localized p* followed by localized j* to localized (j≫p)* is the inverse exact-functor composition comparison followed by localization of the inverse of the existing upperStarCompIso. On separated finite-type schemes use the actual left-first sheaf tensor, total tensor and derived tensor of [def-sf-native-derived-tensor-layer]. The total summand map at p+q=n is exactly HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor for the flipped native tensor bifunctor. The K-flat tensor model is the already proved natural comparison nativeDerivedTensor_models, evaluated on P,T and their two NativeIsKFlat proofs. For an open immersion j:U→Z between separated finite-type schemes, define forgetting/extension and forgetting/pullback comparison isomorphisms by the exact-functor composition factors, localization of the identity comparison on the underlying actual ordinary functors, and the final exact-functor composition factors. The ordinary tensor and forgetting comparisons are those fixed by [lem-sf-weil-native-closed-forgetful]. These are the unchanged concrete auxiliary operations of the existing native open tensor presentation; no existence assertion for a projection formula is part of this definition.
